items.title: Fal raises $1.3B at $16B valuation as AI inference demand surges
items.summary: Fal, which runs AI video, image and audio models, raised $1.3B led by Bessemer at a $16B valuation, double its April figure. Demand is strong, especially for open-source models.
items.whyItMatters: Signals a maturing market for hosted open audio/video models, which could mean cheaper alternatives for tutor voice and avatar features.

items.title: Anthropic develops FlashProve, open-source system to verify which AI model produced an output
items.summary: Anthropic released a spec and code for a system where labs publish model fingerprints so outputs can be cryptographically verified. It has no plans to deploy it yet.
items.whyItMatters: Worth knowing if the tutor ever needs to prove or audit which model answered, though the tutor link is indirect.
